MAHANADI COALFIELDS RAISES RS 2,295 CRORE AHEAD OF IPO

Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India, secured ₹2,295.24 crore from anchor investors before its initial public offering.
The IPO will list 66.18 crore shares priced between Rs 129 and Rs 136, with subscription opening 19 November and closing 23 November, reflecting strong institutional backing.

For information only. Not investment advice.
